descriptions.w3d_d27a_strike_camera_update_8002c840: Unless the state +76 is 1, reads AIStrike.TargetPoint, Direction and UpVector with 0x800fc2f0. Computes the heading error against +84, wrapped to plus or minus pi. If the target matches +16 within 0.2 per axis and the error is within one degree, posts message 13 once via 0x801613f0 and sets the state to 1. Otherwise walks the camera points +88, +96, +100, +108 towards the target at a property rate and turns +84 towards the heading.
